## Nile Faras — G4 *Friendship is Magic*

Nile Faras is the fan/community name for the pale-green unicorn mare from the desert town of Somnambula. Look for her long dark-blue mane and tail, turquoise eyes, gold earring, and cream-and-sky-blue clothes. She appears near Pinkie Pie and other townsponies during the dispute over Daring Do's supposed thefts.

[![Nile Faras (right), with Pinkie Pie and Somnambula residents — Hasbro Studios show still](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2020/7/23/1986965/medium.png)](https://www.twibooru.org/1986965)

*Image: show capture from “Daring Done?”; original animation © Hasbro Studios, archived on Twibooru.*

**Names and continuity.** “Nile Faras” is a community-identification name, not a name spoken in the show; its original coiner is not established by the sources checked. Gameloft's licensed *My Little Pony* mobile game calls the same character **Smiley Somnambulan**, with a description of a welcoming local who may disagree with visitors. That is a *game label*, not an established in-show personal name. See the [G4 unicorn character catalogue](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Unicorn_ponies) and [Gameloft's character list](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Characters/R_-_T).

**Speaking and appearances.** She **does speak**: the [“Daring Done?” transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Daring_Done%3F) assigns her “You stole our glowpaz!” when Caballeron's theft is exposed. No individual voice performer could be verified for that line. Besides **“Daring Done?” (S7E18)**, the character catalogue lists background appearances in **“Shadow Play — Part 1” (S7E25)**, **“Road to Friendship” (S8E19)**, and **“A Rockhoof and a Hard Place” (S8E21)**.

## Important moments

- **A town turns against Daring Do — “Daring Done?” (S7E18).** Nile is among the Somnambula locals caught up in the accusations surrounding stolen glowpaz, supplying the stakes for Rainbow Dash and Pinkie Pie's defense of Daring. [Watch the episode on Tubi](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200165193/s07-e18-daring-done) (scene timestamp unavailable).
- **Calls out Caballeron's theft — “Daring Done?” (S7E18).** When the stolen glowpaz tumbles out, she publicly identifies the theft, helping expose Caballeron's lie and vindicate Daring Do. [Official full-episode upload](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IloBsX0DN2s&t=1294s) (link starts the episode within a compilation; exact scene timestamp unavailable).

**Fan artwork:** Equestria Daily's [Drawfriend gallery #3253, entry 19](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2020/02/drawfriend-stuff-pony-art-gallery-3253.html?variant=3181225977953) credits a work titled *Nile Faras* to **omnisimon11**. The gallery verifies the credit, but the original DeviantArt post could not be opened for further metadata.
